Q954.reason: Consent, hygiene and checking expiry dates all come before catheterization, but ringing the next of kin does not.

Q916.reason: Large-bore 14-16G cannulas are used for rapid fluid resuscitation in trauma or burns patients, not for elderly patients, who have fragile veins.
